name: Samoa
description: Samoa from the Lapita voyagers to the Tui Manu'a and fa'a Samoa, German and New Zealand rule, the Mau movement and independence in 1962.

checkpoints.name: Polynesians
checkpoints.note: Samoa was settled some 3,000 years ago and became a heart of Polynesia.

checkpoints.name: German and New Zealand rule
checkpoints.note: Germany took the western islands in 1900; New Zealand took them in 1914, and the Mau movement began.

checkpoints.name: Independent Samoa
checkpoints.note: Samoa became independent in 1962, the first in the Pacific.
